svg.data-vd-steps: [[0, "A respirometer measures the rate of respiration as oxygen uptake."], [1, "Germinating seeds respire: they take in O\u2082 and give out CO\u2082."], [3.5, "The CO\u2082 is absorbed by potassium hydroxide or soda lime."], [6, "So the gas volume falls, and the coloured liquid moves towards the seeds."], [10, "In the control tube with glass beads, the liquid stays still."], [12.5, "Rate = volume of O\u2082 \u00f7 time, where volume = distance \u00d7 \u03c0r\u00b2."]]
svg.title: A simple respirometer
svg.desc: A respirometer: germinating seeds on gauze above potassium hydroxide in a sealed tube in a water bath; as oxygen is used and carbon dioxide absorbed, coloured liquid moves along a capillary scale; a control with glass beads stays still.
svg.text: Both tubes sealed and in the same water bath.

g.data-info: Keeps the temperature constant, since gas volume changes with temperature.
Germinating seeds or small invertebrates (e.g. woodlice), on a gauze platform.
Same set-up with glass beads of the same volume instead of organisms: corrects for temperature and pressure changes.
Potassium hydroxide solution or soda lime absorbs the CO₂ the organisms give out.
As O₂ is used up and CO₂ is absorbed, the gas volume falls and the liquid moves towards the organisms.
g.text: coloured liquid moves towards the seeds

g.data-info: Read the distance moved in a set time. Volume of O₂ = distance × πr² (r = capillary radius).
Resets the liquid to the start between readings.

g.text: liquid moved 20 mm in 10 min; capillary radius 0.5 mm
divide by the mass of seeds to compare samples
